run_test_fast_rcnn_network: run a Fast R-CNN network test on an image database using a config file and model weights
run_test_net_with_range: run test_net on a specific range of indices for parallel subprocess inference on a dataset
run_multi_gpu_testing: run multi-GPU testing on a Fast R-CNN network using cfg.NUM_GPUS for inference
run_rpn_only_testing: run RPN-only model testing on a dataset to generate region proposals across multiple datasets
run_test_with_auto_weights: run network testing that auto-discovers model weights from the output directory if no weights are specified
